description: Public-web discovery, historical snapshots, registry facts, and broad events under review policy. 1.1.0 adds the optional movements feature (#2221): aircraft registry entries (FAA, UK CAA G-INFO), bounded OpenSky samples, GFW port visits, open AIS samples and UNCTAD port-call aggregates, each for explicitly named identifiers and windows under docs/security/osint-movements-access.md. 1.2.0 adds the News bundle's fact-checks features (#2659): Google Fact Check Tools claim-search results, the Data Commons ClaimReview feed and the IFCN signatories listing, ratings as published (no verdict or normalisation) and claimants as named under the FC01 minimisation decision. 1.2.0 also adds the optional platform-transparency features (#2580): DSA Transparency Database statements of reasons from light daily dumps, Meta Ad Library political and issue ads and Google political ads for explicitly selected platforms, pages and advertisers, with spend and impression ranges as published and the SP01 data-minimisation decision (docs/development/platform-transparency-evidence/source-audit.md); Lumen is recorded as not implemented.

sources.scope: public domain-registration data for declared source domains, fetched from the registry server named by the IANA bootstrap; natural-person registrant data dropped before storage

sources.publisher: Google (Fact Check Tools API, Fact Checked Claim Search)
sources.scope: ClaimReview results of the Fact Check Tools claims:search method for declared queries or review-publisher sites (maxAgeDays at most 366): publisher, review URL, title and date, claim text as quoted, claimant as named and textual rating verbatim; no verdict or normalised rating (placeholder selection until the FC13 live run)
sources.temporal_semantics: reviewDate as published orders revisions of a (publisher site, review URL) record; claim date as published; acquisition time recorded separately; a result missing from a later search is not a removal

license.redistribution: Google APIs Terms of Service (operator must confirm the Fact Check Tools API terms); each fact-check and rating belongs to its publisher and is shown as a cited quotation with a link

sources.update_cadence: weekly at most, on the declared selection only

sources.scope: one ClaimReview DataFeed release filtered to at most 50 declared publisher sites and a review-date window of at most 366 days; reviewRating values with the publisher's own scale verbatim; natural-person review authors, images and claimant job titles withheld (FC01); feed path and size must be verified
sources.temporal_semantics: each release is a vintage (feed dateModified and response digest); datePublished and dateModified as published order revisions; a review missing from a later release of the same selection is an absent-from-release revision

license.redistribution: compilation licensed CC BY with attribution to Data Commons (operator must confirm); each markup's structured data is licensed as its sdLicense states; publishers' articles are never fetched

sources.update_cadence: weekly at most, on the declared selection only

sources.publisher: International Fact-Checking Network at Poynter (Code of Principles signatories)
sources.scope: the IFCN signatories listing (at most 500 signatories): name, profile, website, country and status label and date as published; a live fetch is refused until an operator records a terms confirmation (FC01); listing markup must be verified
sources.temporal_semantics: status date as published where shown, else the acquisition date; a changed status is a dated revision; a signatory missing from a later listing is an absent-from-listing revision

license.redistribution: no reuse terms found (verify); status labels are cited with a link to the profile; no live fetch until the operator confirms the site terms

sources.update_cadence: weekly at most, on the declared selection only

sources.scope: statements of reasons from the light daily dumps of explicitly selected platforms and days, keyed by platform and statement uuid; the notifier identity, the platform's user or content identifier and free-text fields are never stored (SP01)
sources.temporal_semantics: the dump day and the statement's application and creation dates as published; each dump is identified by platform, day, version and its published SHA-1; a republished dump or a changed statement is a new revision

license.redistribution: Commission reuse policy expected (Decision 2011/833/EU); cite the DSA Transparency Database (operator must verify the terms)

sources.scope: political and issue ads (ad_type POLITICAL_AND_ISSUE_ADS) of explicitly selected page ids, countries and a delivery window of at most 366 days: page as the advertiser as declared, bylines as the funding entity as declared, delivery dates and spend and impression ranges with currency exactly as published; no creative text, snapshot URL, demographic or regional breakdown
sources.temporal_semantics: delivery start and stop as published; no revision stamp is published, so each acquisition of a declared unit is compared with the stored revision and an ad no longer returned is a not-returned revision

license.redistribution: citations and ranges as published under the Meta Platform Terms (operator must verify)

sources.temporal_semantics: date ranges as published; the table lastModifiedTime is stored per record as the data refresh date and orders revisions; an ad no longer returned for the same unit is a not-returned revision
